title: Smart Queue · Two-minute demo
text: Smart Queue turns a canceled appointment into an earlier visit. Here is the two-minute demo.

title: 01 · María needs to cancel
text: María Rodríguez needs to cancel her two o'clock visit. Ana, the office assistant, confirms the cancellation in the provider workspace.

title: 02 · An opening becomes an opportunity
text: The appointment is now available. Smart Queue checks the waiting list for compatible patients, using provider, visit type, and availability.

title: 03 · Staff confirms priority
text: Ana can confirm a scheduling priority for José. Urgent priority helps organize the queue, but this is not automated medical triage. Compatibility still comes first.

title: 04 · Ana offers the opening to José
text: José is eligible for the afternoon opening. Ana reviews the candidate and sends the simulated offer. His original appointment stays in place until he accepts.

title: 05 · The patient stays in control
text: In the patient view, José sees the earlier appointment. He can accept, decline, or request help. No account or password is needed for this demo.

title: 06 · Explicit acceptance moves the appointment
text: José previews the change from October twenty-second to October eighth, then confirms. That is fourteen days earlier. The schedule and waiting list update together.

title: 07 · Dr. Rivera sees the updated schedule
text: Back in the provider schedule, José now occupies the released slot. Staff and Dr. Rivera see the same updated appointment.

title: 08 · Separate monthly demo: capacity and statistics
text: A separate monthly scenario shows utilization. Day, week, and month views calculate totals from synthetic appointments. Staff can configure hours, visit duration, and capacity.

title: 09 · Cancellation updates availability
text: Select a day and cancel a scheduled visit with staff confirmation. Occupied seats decrease, availability increases, and the cancellation count updates immediately.

title: 10 · Refill the slot; measure the result
text: Ana confirms the waiting-list assignment. Occupancy recovers, and the fill rate updates.

title: Smart Queue — Less Waiting. Better Care.
text: Fictional patients. Browser-only simulation. Smart Queue. Less waiting. Better care.
